method: Node CPU construction of full pre/post source snapshots; source tree hashes must match the finite browser manifest. Real Three.js geometry, attributes, material values and layout transforms. Deterministic canvas command stub for non-image drawing; screenLabels=false matching the finite fixture; no renderer, frustum culling, GTAO or timing measurement.
limitations: Inventories are source geometry and typed-array byte counts, not GPU memory or process memory.
Visible triangle potential does not account for view frustum, occlusion, shadow passes or renderer passes.
No frame-time, CPU/GPU-time, heat, battery or performance gain is measured or inferred.
CPU canvas command comparisons verify generated drawing instructions, not rasterized browser text; live artwork/content is reviewed separately.
